summary: Listed as a Georgia lookout tower at the former town of Tarver, Echols County; no source found on its history or the site today.

evidence.supports: Tarver is an extinct town in Echols County
evidence.quote: Tarver is an extinct town in Echols County
The Georgia General Assembly incorporated Tarver as a town in 1887.
The town's municipal charter officially was repealed in 1995.

evidence.supports: site along Georgia State Route 94 at New Barnes Road and Will Rewis Road, east of Statenville
evidence.quote: The site of Tarver is along Georgia State Route 94 and the intersections with New Barnes Road and Will Rewis Road east of Statenville

notes_for_editor: Thin. Sources are the tnlandforms list line (coordinates, county, elevation, no tag) and Wikipedia's community article. Two searches and the cache found no tower history. The Wikipedia point (30.70167, -82.92417) is about 100 m from the list point; no correction proposed. The list gives elevation 153 with no units; the record converts it as feet. The story runs about 88 words, below the guide's ~120-word floor; hold or publish as a stub.
